learning_outcomes.text: Gets the habit of reading books, follows daily papers and other written media.
Can calculate the effects of the foreign words on the language, sees the effects of culture on language.
Uses Turkish in an appropriate way.
Makes a presentation in front of people, information and thoughts for others to understand the level of expression, effective communications.
It evaluates Turkish texts according to different systems of thought.

syllabus_topics: What is language? The place and importance of language as a social institution in the life of a nation; the relationship between language and culture.
The place of the Turkish language among the languages of the world.
The development and historical stages of the Turkish language.
The current state and areas of distribution of the Turkish language.
Rules regarding sound characteristics and phonology in the Turkish language
The structure of the syllable and the syllables of Turkish.
Roots, stems, and suffixes in Turkish.
Derivational and inflectional suffixes in a practical text.
Fundamental characteristics and differences of written and oral communication
bibliography: Ali Torun vd., Türk Dili ve Kompozisyon Bilgileri, Kütahya, DPÜ Yayını, 2010.
Ali Torun vd., Türk Dili ve Kompozisyon Bilgileri, Kütahya, DPÜ Yayını, 2010.
